turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:

I eat fruit. He eats fruit.
I see "he", so I add -s to "eat".
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: She helps her friends. Wrong: She help her friends.

Your turn. Write only the verb:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
